Chapter IV · Almost three years

Three years of us 💗

“Teen saal hone wale hain… aur sach kahun, har din tumse pyaar karne ka ek naya reason de jaata hai. ❤️”

In almost three years, we have collected so many little moments—laughs, talks, memories, silly fights and countless reasons to smile. 🌸

Tum sirf meri story ka ek chapter nahi ho, tum meri favourite story ho. 💗
Waqt badalta rahe, saal guzarte rahein, bas meri wish hai ki har naye saal mein hum ek-doosre ke aur kareeb rahein. ♾️

“Agar mujhe phir se choose karna pade, toh main har baar tumhe hi choose karunga.” 🌹

Almost 3 years down, and I still want countless more beautiful chapters with you. 💕
